description: Get one frame of a video (YouTube, Instagram, X, TikTok, a direct .mp4 link…) as a JPEG image, to see what is on screen at a given time. Pair with llms_full_txt: the transcript is timestamped.

t.description: Time in the video: seconds ("90", "90.5") or "1:30" / "1:02:03". Default "0".

url.description: The video link, e.g. "youtube.com/watch?v=…" or "instagram.com/reel/…". The scheme is optional.

name: video_frame
title: Frame of a video
